section.content: 本发明提供了一种锂离子电池及锂离子电池组，所述锂离子电池包括若干正极片、若干负极片、若干隔膜纸、第三电极片、三个电极引出端子、第一带孔载流基体和第二带孔载流基体，所述第三电极片包括导电基层和含锂活性层，通过所述第三电极片和正极片或负极片进行初次充放电，使锂离子电池进入预锂化或自修复进程，降低预锂化操作的锂离子消耗，提高了锂离子电池生产效率，降低了预锂化成本，安全性高。本发明的所述锂离子电池组包括若干本发明所述的锂离子电池，锂离子电池组也具有预锂化和自修复功能，大大提高电池的容量和能量，减少电池能量和容量的衰减，提高电池循环使用寿命。

The invention provides a lithium ion battery and a lithium ion battery pack, wherein the lithium ion battery comprises a plurality of positive plates, a plurality of negative plates, a plurality of diaphragm papers, a third electrode slice, three electrode leading-out terminals, a first current-carrying substrate with a hole and a second current-carrying substrate with a hole, the third electrode slice comprises a conductive base layer and a lithium-containing active layer, and the lithium ion battery enters a pre-lithiation or self-repairing process through the first charge and discharge of the third electrode slice and the positive plates or the negative plates, so that the lithium ion consumption in the pre-lithiation operation is reduced, the production efficiency of the lithium ion battery is improved, the pre-lithiation cost is reduced, and the. The lithium ion battery pack comprises a plurality of lithium ion batteries, and the lithium ion battery pack also has the functions of prelithiation and self-repair, so that the capacity and energy of the batteries are greatly improved, the attenuation of the energy and capacity of the batteries is reduced, and the cycle service life of the batteries is prolonged.

Lithium ion battery and lithium ion battery packTechnical Field

The invention relates to the technical field of batteries, in particular to a lithium ion battery and a lithium ion battery pack.

Background

During the first charge of a lithium ion battery, lithium ions are extracted from the positive electrode and enter the negative electrode, and then extracted from the negative electrode and enter the positive electrode during the discharge. In this process, the capacity of the positive electrode material is attenuated by about 5% to 15%, which is caused by the formation of solid electrolyte films (SEI films) on the surfaces of the positive and negative electrode sheets, thereby consuming a certain amount of lithium ions. Thus reducing the capacity of the battery, resulting in a decrease in the first efficiency of the battery. In the lithium ion battery manufacturing industry, graphite is generally used as an active material for a negative electrode material, but the first charge-discharge efficiency is only 93%, so that 7% of lithium ions of a positive electrode can be consumed; the utilization efficiency of the positive active material is seriously affected.

Studies inherent in the lithium ion battery industry use lithium foil or lithium powder for prelithiation. The aluminum foil is adopted for pre-lithiation, so that the defects that the manufacturing process is complex, and a plurality of additional processes are required to be added for rolling and transferring the lithium foil exist, and the wettability of the negative electrode material is influenced to a certain extent.

In addition, in the use process of the lithium ion battery, the capacity and the energy can be continuously attenuated, and the main attenuation mechanism is the consumption of the solid electrolyte film on the surface of the negative plate caused by the continuous charge-discharge expansion process of the negative active material, so that the lithium ions of the positive material are continuously consumed, and finally the service life of the battery is attenuated.

The invention patent with publication number CN 109742325A discloses a method for pre-lithiating a negative plate of a lithium ion battery step by step. The method comprises the following steps: providing at least three pre-lithiation units including a first pre-lithiation unit, a second pre-lithiation unit and a last pre-lithiation unit, wherein each pre-lithiation unit comprises an electrolyte containing lithium salt and a charging module for carrying out formation charging on a lithium ion battery negative plate; and sequentially introducing the lithium ion battery negative plate into the first pre-lithiation unit, the second pre-lithiation unit and finally the final pre-lithiation unit, and sequentially immersing the lithium ion battery negative plate into the electrolyte contained in each pre-lithiation unit to carry out infiltration treatment and charging treatment through the charging module. The method for pre-lithiating the lithium ion battery negative plate step by step realizes pre-lithiation step by step, and realizes uniform lithium supplement and accurate lithium supplement on the lithium ion battery negative plate. According to the invention, the three pre-lithiation units are used for sequentially carrying out pre-lithiation operation on the negative electrode, the operation process is complicated, the battery negative electrode piece needs to be sequentially introduced into the three pre-lithiation units for infiltration and finally recharging, and the pre-lithiation operation process is complicated and long in time, so that the pre-lithiation cost is high and the pre-lithiation efficiency is low.

Therefore, it is necessary to provide a lithium ion battery to solve the above problems in the prior art.

Disclosure of Invention

The invention aims to provide a lithium ion battery and a lithium ion battery pack, and aims to solve the problems of complex manufacturing process and continuous capacity attenuation in the pre-lithiation process of the lithium ion battery.

In order to achieve the purpose, the lithium ion battery comprises three electrode leading-out terminals, a third electrode plate, a plurality of positive plates, a plurality of diaphragm paper and a plurality of negative plates, wherein the positive plates are connected with the negative plates through the diaphragm paper;

the three electrode leading-out terminals are respectively a positive electrode leading-out terminal, a negative electrode leading-out terminal and a third electrode leading-out terminal, the positive electrode leading-out terminal is connected with the plurality of positive electrode plates, the negative electrode leading-out terminal is connected with the plurality of negative electrode plates, and the third electrode leading-out terminal is connected with the third electrode plate;

charging and discharging the lithium ion battery through the third electrode plate and the positive plate or through the third electrode plate and the negative plate, so that the lithium ion battery enters a pre-lithiation or self-repair process;

the anode plate is provided with a first current-carrying matrix with holes, the cathode plate is provided with a second current-carrying matrix with holes, and the third electrode plate comprises a conductive base layer and a lithium-containing active layer.

The lithium ion battery has the beneficial effects that:

the third electrode plate is reasonably arranged on the traditional lithium ion battery structure, and the lithium-containing active layer is arranged on the third electrode plate, so that when the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged for the first time, the lithium-containing active layer of the third electrode plate is electrified to generate lithium ions, the positive plate or the negative plate is pre-lithiated, the consumption of the lithium ions on the positive plate or the negative plate, which are consumed by the formation of the solid electrolyte membrane on the surfaces of the positive plate and the negative plate, is reduced, and the capacity storage rate of the lithium ion battery after the lithium ion battery is charged for the first time is improved. The prelithiation operation flow is simple and efficient, the production efficiency of the lithium ion battery is greatly improved, automatic prelithiation is performed during charging and discharging, the prelithiation operation difficulty and the prelithiation material manufacturing cost are reduced, the prelithiation cost and the production cost of the lithium ion battery are reduced, and the safety is high; when the capacity of the lithium ion battery is attenuated, the battery can be charged and discharged again through the third electrode plate and the positive plate or the negative plate, so that the lithium ion battery enters a self-repairing treatment process, lithium ions of the positive plate consumed by the formation of the solid electrolyte membrane on the surface of the negative plate are reduced, the capacity attenuation of the lithium ion battery is reduced, and the service life of the lithium ion battery in cyclic charging and discharging is prolonged. The invention also provides a first current-carrying matrix with holes and a second current-carrying matrix with holes, thereby improving the ion conduction rate, improving the speed of the positive electrode and the negative electrode for gathering ions and improving the charging and discharging efficiency of the lithium ion battery.

Preferably, the first and second porous current-carrying substrates each have a porosity of 1% -98%. The beneficial effects are that: the pores enable the ion conduction rate of the first current-carrying matrix with the holes and the second current-carrying matrix with the holes, so that the current gathering speed of the current-carrying matrix with the holes is ensured, and the flowing speed of ions on the positive plate and the negative plate is improved.

Preferably, the first and second porous current-carrying substrates are any one or more of porous metal foil, foamed metal material, and porous plastic composite base material.

Preferably, the number of the third electrode sheets is at least 1.

Preferably, the third electrode sheet is connected with the negative electrode sheet through the separator paper, and the lithium-containing active layer is close to the adjacent negative electrode sheet. The beneficial effects are that: the lithium-containing active layer of the third electrode plate is connected with the negative plate on the outermost side, so that charging and discharging are facilitated through the third electrode plate and the negative plate, and the purposes of pre-lithiation of the negative plate and reduction of the attenuation of the capacity of the lithium ion battery are achieved.

Further preferably, the third electrode tab is disposed at a side portion of the negative electrode tab at the outermost side of the lithium ion battery.

Further preferably, the third electrode tab is disposed between the positive electrode tab and the negative electrode tab.

Preferably, the third electrode sheet is connected with the positive electrode sheet through the separator paper, and the lithium-containing active layer is close to the adjacent positive electrode sheet. The beneficial effects are that: the lithium-containing active layer of the third electrode plate is connected with the positive plate, so that charging and discharging are facilitated through the third electrode plate and the positive plate, and the purposes of pre-lithiation of the positive plate and reduction of the attenuation of the capacity of the lithium ion battery are achieved.

Preferably, the composition material of the lithium-containing active layer is one or a composite of a plurality of metal lithium, lithium cobaltate, lithium manganate, lithium iron phosphate, lithium iron manganese phosphate, lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, ternary nickel cobalt aluminum material, lithium-rich layered material, nickel manganese spinel material and lithium-containing high molecular compound.

Preferably, one positive plate is clamped between every two adjacent negative plates, and one negative plate is clamped between every two adjacent positive plates. The beneficial effects are that: the positive plate and the negative plate are arranged at intervals in a staggered mode, and the charging efficiency and the stored energy of the lithium ion battery are improved due to the cooperation of the positive plates and the negative plates.

Preferably, the positive plate comprises a positive active material, and the positive active material is one or a combination of more of lithium cobaltate, lithium manganate, lithium iron phosphate, lithium iron manganese phosphate, lithium nickel cobalt manganese manganate, a ternary material of nickel cobalt aluminum, a lithium-rich layered material, and a nickel manganese spinel material.

Preferably, the negative electrode sheet comprises a negative electrode active material, and the negative electrode active material is one or more of natural graphite, artificial graphite, mesocarbon microbeads, lithium titanate, silicon or silicon-carbon alloy, tin alloy and active lithium metal.

Preferably, the battery further comprises a battery case, wherein electrolyte is arranged in the battery case, the positive plate, the negative plate and the third electrode plate are fixed in the battery case, a battery cover is arranged at the top of the battery case, and the positive lead-out terminal, the negative lead-out terminal and the third electrode lead-out terminal are fixed on the battery cover.

The invention also provides a lithium ion battery pack which comprises a plurality of lithium ion batteries.

The lithium ion battery pack has the beneficial effects that:

because the lithium ion battery pack is formed by combining a plurality of lithium ion batteries, the lithium ion battery pack is charged and discharged through the third electrode plate and the positive plate or the negative plate when being charged and discharged for the first time, so that the positive plate or the negative plate is pre-lithiated, the lithium ion consumption of the pre-lithiation operation of the battery pack is reduced, the pre-lithiation operation process is simple and efficient, the production efficiency of the battery pack is greatly improved, and the pre-lithiation cost of the battery pack and the production cost of the lithium ion battery pack are reduced; when the capacity of the battery is attenuated, the battery can be charged and discharged again through the third electrode plate and the positive plate or the negative plate, so that the battery pack enters a self-repairing treatment process, the energy and capacity attenuation speed of the lithium ion battery pack are reduced, and the cycle service life of the lithium ion battery pack is greatly prolonged.

Detailed Description

In order to make the objects, technical solutions and advantages of the present invention clearer, the technical solutions in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the accompanying drawings of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are some, but not all embodiments of the present invention. All other embodiments, which can be derived by a person skilled in the art from the embodiments given herein without making any creative effort, shall fall within the protection scope of the present invention. Unless defined otherwise, technical or scientific terms used herein shall have the ordinary meaning as understood by one of ordinary skill in the art to which this invention belongs. As used herein, the word "comprising" and similar words are intended to mean that the element or item listed before the word covers the element or item listed after the word and its equivalents, but does not exclude other elements or items.

Example one

The embodiment of the invention provides a lithium ion battery.

Fig. 1 is a schematic front view of a lithium ion battery according to a first embodiment of the present invention. The lithium ion battery shown in fig. 1 includes a plurality of positive electrode sheets 1, a plurality of negative electrode sheets 2, separator paper (not shown) and a third electrode sheet 3, the separator paper (not shown) includes a first separator paper 4 and a second separator paper 5, the first separator paper 4 is connected between the positive electrode sheets 1 and the negative electrode sheets 2, the second separator paper 5 is connected between the third electrode sheet 3 and the positive electrode sheets 1 or between the third positive electrode sheets 3 and the negative electrode sheets 2, and the third electrode sheet 3 includes a conductive base layer 30 and a lithium-containing active layer 31.

In the first embodiment of the present invention, the lithium ion battery further includes three electrode lead-out terminals, where the three electrode lead-out terminals are a positive electrode lead-out terminal, a negative electrode lead-out terminal, a third electrode lead-out terminal, a first current-carrying substrate with a hole, and a second current-carrying substrate with a hole.

Fig. 2 is a side cross-sectional view of a lithium ion battery according to a first embodiment of the present invention. Referring to fig. 2, the positive lead terminal 10 is connected to all the positive electrode tabs 1, the negative lead terminal 20 is connected to all the negative electrode tabs 2, and the third electrode lead terminal 32 is connected to the third electrode tab 3.

The positive plate 1 is provided with a first current-carrying matrix with holes 12, the negative plate 2 is provided with a second current-carrying matrix with holes 21, and the first current-carrying matrix with holes 12 and the second current-carrying matrix with holes 21 are both provided with holes 11.

When the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged for the first time, the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged for the first time through the third electrode plate 3 and the positive plate 1 or through the third positive plate 3 and the negative plate 2, and pre-lithiation operation is performed on the positive plate 1 or the negative plate 2.

When the capacity of the lithium ion battery is reduced, the lithium ion battery enters a self-repairing treatment process through the third electrode plate 3 and the positive plate 1 or through the third positive plate 3 and the negative plate 2 for charging and discharging again. The secondary charging and discharging is non-primary charging and discharging or primary charging and discharging, is not limited to secondary charging and discharging, and may also refer to an nth (N is an integer greater than two) charging and discharging process.

The lithium ion battery has the advantages that:

at traditional lithium ion battery rational arrangement of structural third electrode piece 3, when first charge-discharge, through third electrode piece 3 and positive plate 1 or negative plate 2 charge-discharge, thereby make positive plate 1 or negative plate 2 lithiate in advance, reduce the consumption of the lithium ion on positive plate 1 or the negative plate 2 that positive plate 1 and negative plate 2 surface solid electrolyte membrane's formation consumed, thereby reduce the lithium ion consumption of the operation of the lithiation in advance of battery, and lithiation operation flow is simple high-efficient in advance, lithium ion battery production efficiency has been improved greatly, the cost of lithiation in advance and lithium ion battery's manufacturing cost has been reduced. When the capacity of the battery is attenuated, the battery can be charged and discharged again through the third electrode plate 3 and the positive electrode plate 1 or the third electrode plate 3 and the negative electrode plate 1, the lithium-containing active layer 31 of the third electrode plate 3 is electrified to generate lithium ions, and the lithium ions of the positive electrode plate 1 consumed by the formation of the solid electrolyte membrane on the surface of the negative electrode plate 2 are reduced, so that the lithium ion battery enters a self-repairing treatment process, the energy and capacity attenuation speed of the lithium ion battery are reduced, and the service life of the lithium ion battery is greatly prolonged. The invention also arranges the first current-carrying matrix with holes 12 and the second current-carrying matrix with holes 21, thereby improving the ion conduction rate, improving the speed of the current-carrying matrix for gathering ions, improving the speed of positive and negative electrodes for gathering ions, and improving the charging and discharging efficiency of the lithium ion battery.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, fig. 3 is a schematic diagram of a package structure of a lithium ion battery according to a first embodiment of the present invention. Referring to fig. 3, the lithium ion battery according to the first embodiment of the present invention further includes a battery case 7 and an electrolyte 8, where the electrolyte 8 is filled in an inner space of the battery case 7. The positive plate 1, the negative plate 2 and the third electrode plate 3 are all fixed in the battery case 7, and the positive plate 1, the negative plate 2 and the third electrode plate 3 are all soaked in the electrolyte 8. The top of the battery can 7 has a battery cover to which a positive electrode lead-out terminal 10, a negative electrode lead-out terminal 20, and a third electrode lead-out terminal 32 are fixed. The advantages are that: the positive electrode leading-out terminal 10, the negative electrode leading-out terminal 20 and the third electrode leading-out terminal 32 are led out of the battery shell, so that the lithium ion battery is convenient to charge and discharge. The positive plate 1, the negative plate 2 and the third electrode plate 3 are soaked in the electrolyte 8, so that the pre-lithiation and self-repairing processes of the lithium ion battery are facilitated.

The battery case 7 is provided with an injection hole 6 for injecting the electrolyte 8. Its advantage does: the injection hole is convenient for the notes liquid operation of group battery, conveniently injects the electrolyte into the battery case, improves lithium ion battery group assembly efficiency.

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, referring to fig. 2, the first and second perforated current carrying substrates 12 and 21 each have a porosity of 1% to 98%. The advantages of providing first and second perforated current-carrying substrates 12, 21 with apertures 11 are: the plurality of holes 11 improve the ion conductivity of the first current-carrying matrix with holes and the second current-carrying matrix with holes, so that the current gathering speed of the current-carrying matrixes with holes is ensured, and the flowing speed of ions and current on the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2 is improved. And the pores 10 can reduce the weight of the current-carrying matrix with the pores, thereby effectively improving the energy density of the lithium ion battery.

Referring to fig. 1, the third electrode sheet 3 is connected to the negative electrode sheet 2 through a separator paper, and specifically, the lithium-containing active layer 31 is connected to the adjacent negative electrode sheet 2 through the second separator paper 5. Its advantage does: the lithium ion battery is provided with the lithium-containing active layer 31, and the lithium-containing active layer 31 is close to and connected with the negative plate 2, so that the negative plate 2 is subjected to pre-lithiation when the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged for the first time, and lithium-containing active substances on the lithium-containing active layer flow onto the negative plate 2 when the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged for the first time, so that the negative plate 2 is subjected to pre-lithiation, the lithium ion consumption on the positive plate is reduced, and the capacity storage rate of the lithium ion battery after the lithium ion battery is charged for the first time is improved.

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the conductive base layer 30 is made of a conductive material such as a copper foil material. The lithium-containing active layer 31 is made of one or more of metallic lithium, lithium cobaltate, lithium manganate, lithium iron phosphate, lithium iron manganese phosphate, lithium nickel cobalt manganese, ternary nickel cobalt aluminum material, lithium-rich layered material, nickel manganese spinel material and lithium-containing high molecular compound.

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the first and second perforated current-carrying substrates 12 and 21 are each one or more of a metal foil, a foamed metal material, a porous plastic composite substrate, and the like.

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, one positive electrode sheet 1 is interposed between every two adjacent negative electrode sheets 2, and one negative electrode sheet 2 is interposed between every two adjacent positive electrode sheets 1. Its advantage does: positive plate 1 and the crisscross interval setting of negative pole piece 2, the charge efficiency and the stored energy of lithium ion battery are improved in the cooperation of a plurality of positive plate 1 and negative pole piece 2.

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the number of the third electrode sheets 3 is one or more.

Referring to fig. 1, the number of the third electrode tabs 3 is two, the third electrode tabs 3 are disposed on the side surface of the negative electrode sheet 2 on the outermost side of the lithium ion battery, and the two third electrode tabs 3 are respectively connected to the two negative electrode sheets 2 through two second separator papers 5. The first third electrode sheet 3 is connected with the leftmost negative electrode sheet 2 through the second separator paper 5, and the second third electrode sheet 3 is connected with the rightmost negative electrode sheet 2 through the second separator paper 5. Its advantage does: the third electrode plate 3 is connected with the cathode plate 2 on the outermost side, so that charging and discharging are facilitated through the third electrode plate 3 and the cathode plate 2, and the purposes of pre-lithiation of the cathode plate and reduction of attenuation of the capacity of the lithium ion battery are achieved.

Fig. 4 is a cross-sectional view of a lithium ion battery in a second embodiment of the first embodiment of the present invention. Referring to fig. 4, as a second embodiment of the lithium ion battery according to the first embodiment of the present invention, the number of the third electrode tabs 3 is one, and the third electrode tabs 3 are disposed on the side surface of the outermost negative electrode tab 2 of the lithium ion battery.

Optionally, the third electrode sheet 3 of the present invention is not limited to be located on the outer side of the lithium ion battery, and may also be located in the middle of the lithium ion battery, or on the non-outer side of the lithium ion battery.

Fig. 5 is a schematic structural diagram of a lithium ion battery in a third embodiment of the first embodiment of the present invention. Referring to fig. 5, in a third embodiment of the lithium ion battery according to the first embodiment of the present invention, the number of the third electrode tabs 3 is two, the third electrode tabs 3 are disposed between the positive electrode sheet 1 and the negative electrode sheet 2, the lithium-containing active layer 31 is attached to the negative electrode sheet 2 through the second separator paper 5, and the conductive base layer 30 is attached to the positive electrode sheet 1 through the second separator paper 5.

In a specific embodiment of the present invention, the lithium-containing active layer 31 is one or more of metal lithium, lithium cobaltate, lithium manganate, lithium iron phosphate, lithium manganese iron phosphate, lithium nickel cobalt manganese, ternary materials of nickel cobalt aluminum, lithium-rich layered materials, nickel manganese spinel materials, and lithium-containing high molecular compounds.

Referring to fig. 1 and 2, the charge and discharge operations and principles of the lithium ion battery employing the first embodiment are as follows:

when the lithium ion battery is first charged and discharged, the positive electrode of the charging device (not shown in the figure) is connected to the third electrode lead-out terminal 32, and the negative electrode of the charging device is connected to the negative electrode lead-out terminal 20, that is, the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the charging device are respectively connected to the third electrode sheet 3 and the negative electrode sheet 2 in sequence, so that the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged, and the negative electrode sheet is pre-lithiated.

When the capacity of the lithium ion battery is attenuated, the anode of the charging device is connected with the third electrode leading-out terminal 32, the cathode of the charging device is connected with the cathode leading-out terminal 20, even if the anode and the cathode of the charging device are respectively connected with the third electrode slice 3 and the cathode slice 2 in sequence, the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged again, the lithium ion battery enters a self-repairing process, and the capacity attenuation of the lithium ion battery is reduced.

The lithium ion battery structure and the charge and discharge method have the advantages that: the lithium-containing active layer 31 of the third electrode plate 3 is connected with the outermost negative electrode plate 2, so that charging and discharging can be conveniently carried out through the third electrode plate 3 and the negative electrode plate 2, and the purposes of pre-lithiation of the negative electrode plate 2 and reduction of the attenuation of the capacity of the lithium ion battery are achieved.

As a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the positive electrode sheet 1 includes a positive electrode active material, and the positive electrode active material is a lithium composite oxide, specifically, the positive electrode active material is one or a combination of more of lithium cobaltate, lithium manganate, lithium iron phosphate, lithium iron manganese phosphate, lithium nickel cobalt manganese, ternary lithium nickel cobalt aluminum material, lithium-rich layered material, and nickel manganese spinel material.

In a preferred embodiment of the present invention, the negative electrode sheet 2 includes a negative electrode active material, specifically, the negative electrode active material is one or a combination of more of natural graphite, artificial graphite, mesocarbon microbeads, lithium titanate, silicon or silicon-carbon alloy, tin alloy, and active lithium metal.

Example two

Fig. 6 is a schematic front view of a lithium ion battery according to a second embodiment of the present invention. Referring to fig. 6, the lithium ion battery of the present invention includes a plurality of positive electrode sheets 1, a plurality of negative electrode sheets 2, separator paper, and a third electrode sheet 3, wherein the separator paper includes a first separator paper 4 and a second separator paper 5, the first separator paper 4 is sandwiched between the positive electrode sheets 1 and the negative electrode sheets 2, the second separator paper 5 is connected to the third electrode sheet 3 and the positive electrode, 1 or between the third positive electrode sheets 3 and the negative electrode sheets 2, and the third electrode sheet 3 includes a conductive base layer 30 and a lithium-containing active layer 31. The positive plates 1 and the negative plates 2 are distributed at intervals, namely, a negative plate 2 is clamped between any two adjacent positive plates 1, and a positive plate 1 is clamped between any two adjacent negative plates 2. One positive plate 1 is positioned at the leftmost side of the lithium ion battery, and the other positive plate 1 is positioned at the rightmost side of the lithium ion battery.

Referring to fig. 6, as a first embodiment of the second embodiment of the present invention, the number of the third electrode tabs 3 is two, one of the third electrode tabs 3 is connected to the leftmost positive electrode tab 1 of the lithium ion battery, and the other third electrode tab 3 is connected to the rightmost positive electrode tab 1 of the lithium ion battery. The lithium-containing active layers 31 of the two third electrode sheets 3 are attached to the positive electrode sheet 1 through the second separator paper 5, and the conductive base layer 30 is attached to the negative electrode sheet 2 through the second separator paper 5.

Fig. 7 is a cross-sectional view of a lithium ion battery in a second embodiment of the second example of the present invention. Referring to fig. 7, as a second embodiment of the present invention, the number of the third electrode sheets 3 is one, the third electrode sheets 3 are connected to the positive electrode sheets 1 on the left or right side of the lithium ion battery, and the lithium-containing active layer 31 is attached to the positive electrode sheets via the second separator paper 5.

Fig. 8 is a cross-sectional view of a lithium ion battery in a third embodiment of example two of the present invention. Referring to fig. 8, as a third embodiment of the second embodiment of the present invention, the number of the third positive electrode sheets 3 is two. The two third electrode plates 3 are both arranged between the positive plate 1 and the negative plate 2. The lithium-containing active layers 31 of the two third positive electrode sheets 3 are respectively connected with the adjacent positive electrode sheets 1 through the second diaphragm paper 5, and the conductive base layer 30 is respectively connected with the adjacent negative electrode sheets 2 through the second diaphragm paper 5.

The third electrode sheet 3 is arranged between any adjacent positive electrode sheet 1 and any adjacent negative electrode sheet 2, the adjacent positive electrode sheet 1 and the adjacent negative electrode sheet 2 are connected through the first diaphragm paper 4, the lithium-containing active layer 31 is connected with the adjacent positive electrode sheet 1 through the second diaphragm paper 5, and the conductive base layer 30 is connected with the adjacent negative electrode sheet 2 through the second diaphragm paper 5.

Referring to fig. 2 and 6, the operation and principle of charging and discharging the lithium ion battery according to the second embodiment of the present invention are as follows:

when the lithium ion battery is charged and discharged for the first time, the positive electrode of the charging device (not shown in the figure) is connected with the positive electrode leading-out terminal 10, and the negative electrode of the charging device is connected with the third electrode leading-out terminal 32, even if the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the charging device are respectively connected with the positive electrode plate 1 and the third electrode plate 3 in sequence to charge and discharge the lithium ion battery for the first time, the lithium-containing active layer 31 of the third electrode plate 3 is charged to generate lithium ions, so that the positive electrode plate 10 is pre-lithiated, and the lithium ion consumption of the electrode plates during charging.

When the capacity of the lithium ion battery is attenuated, the anode of the charging device is connected with the anode leading-out terminal 10, the cathode of the charging device is connected with the third electrode leading-out terminal 32, even if the anode and the cathode of the charging device are respectively connected with the anode plate 1 and the third electrode plate 3 in sequence to charge and discharge the lithium ion battery again, the lithium-containing active layer 31 of the third electrode plate 3 is charged to generate lithium ions, the lithium ions are supplemented in time, the lithium ions of the anode plate consumed by the formation of the solid electrolyte membrane on the surface of the cathode plate are reduced, the capacity attenuation of the lithium ion battery is reduced, the service life of the cycle charge and discharge of the lithium ion battery is prolonged, and the lithium ion battery enters. The beneficial effects are that: the lithium-containing active layer 31 of the third electrode plate 3 is connected with the positive plate 1, so that charging and discharging are facilitated through the third electrode plate 3 and the positive plate 1, and the purposes of pre-lithiation of the positive plate 1 and reduction of attenuation of the capacity of the lithium ion battery are achieved.

The invention also provides a lithium ion battery pack which comprises a plurality of lithium ion batteries of the invention, wherein the plurality of lithium ion batteries are equivalent to single batteries, and the plurality of lithium ion batteries are connected in series or in parallel or in a series-parallel combination mode, so that the lithium ion battery pack is formed.

The lithium ion battery pack has the advantages that:

because the lithium ion battery pack is formed by combining a plurality of lithium ion batteries, the lithium ion battery pack has the functions of pre-lithiation and self-repairing, and the lithium ion battery pack is charged and discharged through the third electrode plate 3 and the negative plate 2 or through the third electrode plate 3 and the positive plate when being charged and discharged for the first time, so that the negative plate 2 or the positive plate 1 is pre-lithiated, the lithium ion consumption of the pre-lithiation operation of the battery pack is reduced, the pre-lithiation operation process is simple and efficient, the production efficiency of the battery pack is greatly improved, and the pre-lithiation cost and the production cost of the lithium ion battery pack are reduced; when the capacity of the battery pack is attenuated, the battery can be charged and discharged again through the third electrode plate 3 and the positive plate 1 or through the third electrode plate 3 and the negative plate 2, so that the battery pack enters a self-repairing treatment process, the energy and capacity attenuation speed of the lithium ion battery pack are reduced, and the cycle service life of the lithium ion battery pack is greatly prolonged.
